question: Optical density and mass density are two distinct physical quantities. Turpentine oil has a higher optical density than water, yet its mass density is lower. If a ray of light travels from water into turpentine oil, how will it behave?

options.A: It will bend away from the normal because turpentine is lighter.
options.B: It will bend towards the normal because turpentine is optically denser.
options.C: It will go undeviated because mass density balances optical density.
options.D: It will undergo total internal reflection.
